sentences.text: Researchers developed a molecular neural network composed of DNA that alters its structure in response to environmental acidity.
This system modifies the connections between its components without adding or removing any molecules.
In a network handling 64-bit data inputs, increased acidity shifted the system from a simple two-category sorter to one distinguishing four patterns.
The findings indicate that DNA circuits can adjust their processing structure based on signals from their surroundings.
